name: Clinicare Naif

owner_description: IMARA Health care’s vision is to provide quality healthcare for an affordable price to the community of Dubai & Northern Emirates, so we introduced a chain of Clinicare Medical Centers and RX Pharmacy brands in the UAE.

reviews.author: Maiko Dungo
reviews.text:
Very good and clean clinic with excellent service. Dr. Shabnam was very professional and provided great care.

Special thanks to SOUMYA, the receptionist, and Nurse Nimisha for being so kind, accommodating, and attentive.

We felt very comfortable throughout our visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: meena gupta
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with my physiotherapist Mrs Anju, my condition was very bad , knee was swollen , fluid around ,  pain, could not even walk a step. She cured me fully in 6 to 8 sittings . She is very good, soft spoken, knowledgeable & friendly. Now I can walk properly, no pain or nothing. God bless her & Clinicare.

reviews.author: Murtaza Suratwala
reviews.text:
I recently received physiotherapy treatment by Dr. Ayesha and I would highly recommend for her if any needs of physio. She is good at massaging and examine the cause. I got relief from my ACL Pain in both knees.
And I'm planning to have some more sessions to get completely cured.
reviews.owner_reply: We are glad your experience in getting treatment was pleasant. Thank you for choosing Clinicare Naif

reviews.author: Fasalsha Fasalsha
reviews.text: I recently had varicose veins treatment with Dr. Renjith, From the initial consultation to the follow-up appointments, Dr. Renjith and his team were professional, caring, and attentive. The procedure was explained thoroughly, and I felt completely at ease throughout the entire process. The treatment itself was quick and painless, and the results have been fantastic – my legs haven't looked this good in years! I highly recommend Dr. Renjith to anyone seeking effective and compassionate care for varicose veins.
reviews.owner_reply: We are glad to know you had a pleasant experience. Thank you for having chosen Clinicare Medical Centre. We strive to give back to the community. For sure, we will share this feedback with Dr. Ranjith. Thank you very much for your feedback.

reviews.author: Naghma Khatoon
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Ms. Anju, the physiotherapist. She did a great job with my mother's osteoarthritis and sciatica pain. My mother started feeling the improvement from the 1st session onwards and with 5 sessions the pain was minimum. Ms. Anju has been very kind and patient and very patient-friendly which is why my mom was very comfortable and trusts her more with her care. She even called 2 days after the sessions ended with her to check up on my mother. Definitely a gem!

reviews.author: Anasuya Ramesh
reviews.text: Today was my final physiotherapy session with Dr. Ashwathy. She knows what type of treatment will help the patient to release the pain. I wish her all the success. Truly helpful and recommended service.

reviews.author: Vinay K P
reviews.text: I had severe shoulder pain, consulted Orthopedic specialist Dr. Adhinarayan He found the route cause of the pain and referred me to Physiotherapist Ms. Aswathy. Brilliant physiotherapist,  friendly team supportive , received follow-up and reminder calls for each session. Awesome service provided by the team highly recommend Clinicare Naif for their best service in each step.
